_readme: The complete set of non-app-specific capabilities the factory provides. Each names ONE owning
package, ONE seam entrypoint, and its real consumers.
Why it exists: the charter's word 'every' is not checkable against an unstated set. Three separate
notification implementations were written because there was no place to look that would have said
one already existed. This is that place.
Enforced by tooling/ci/assert-capability-register.mjs, which checks BOTH directions -- a package on
disk missing from here fails, and an entry here naming a path or consumer that is not real fails.
Consumers are declared AND verified against the consumer's own pubspec, so this file cannot drift
Adding a package means adding an entry. That friction is the point ([pipeline C-4]: a package is

capabilities.capability: App-neutral domain spine — config, caches, entitlement and notification models, and the seam interfaces every other package implements against.
HTTP transport to the shared platform Worker — config, consent and analytics event delivery.
Shared widgets and theming. Deliberately domain-free — the lock decision lives with the caller, never here ([pipeline C-5] boundary).
Secure-token and key-value storage adapters across all six platforms.
Crash and error reporting sink. Wired into Subly at 5f3466b — until then the only live app had no crash reporting at all.

capabilities.note: Deliberately NOT given to apps/subly, which is a frozen legacy rail-prover (39-CHASSIS cut 1). That is why the FLN 17.x pin stays there.

capabilities.capability: Shared analysis ruleset — the one convention set every package and stamped app should inherit.
capabilities.unconsumedReason: ZERO consumers today, including its own analysis_options.yaml where the include sits commented out. Wiring it into every package and the brick template is [pipeline C-12] (one inherited convention set reaches every app), which is PROPOSED and not yet built. Tracked, not waived -- this guard prints it on every run.

capabilities.capability: Design tokens built by style-dictionary into sites/_shared/assets/tokens.css, which the websites serve.
capabilities.unconsumedReason: A Node package with no pubspec.yaml, so it cannot be declared as a Dart dependency and the consumer test does not apply. Its real consumer is sites/_shared/assets/tokens.css, gated by ci.yml's `tokens` lane, which rebuilds the tokens and fails on any diff. The 39-CHASSIS cut-3 'zero consumers, delete it' premise was falsified on 2026-07-26 -- recorded as SUPERSEDED BY FACTS rather than executed blindly.
